expected: Identify the existing check and missing execution path.
Propose wiring that check instead of inventing another check or a duplicate reminder.
Distinguish verified manual coverage from unverified future CI execution.
Report evidence, expected benefit, and verification gap without implementing the proposal.

scenarios.session: The user corrected a deprecated parser API call to the repository's supported replacement. The corrected parser tests passed. Relevant lint configuration and commands were inspected; none checks for the deprecated call.
expected: Classify the banned API as a mechanical invariant.

Keep any separately justified lesson narrow and evidence-backed.
Do not mark an unimplemented check as automation delivery or verified prevention.

expected: Recognize verified existing enforcement.

expected: Distinguish the verified registration correction from the information-access proposal.
Propose exposing the relevant local server error output.
Preserve privacy and authorization boundaries; do not assume new service access.
